title: Check a release
intro: Type the name of a release. nexcrate shows for each version whether it fits and why. Nothing is searched or downloaded.
name: Release name
nameHint: As it appears at the indexer.
movieHint: Optional. Then nexcrate knows the runtime, the original language and the existing files.
movieNone: No movie found in the library.
sizeHint: Optional. Without a size nexcrate checks no size limits.
invalidSize: Enter the size as a number in GB, for example 12.5.
runtimeUnknown: Without a movie nexcrate assumes a runtime of 110 minutes.
parsedTitle: What nexcrate reads from the name
forNowHint: Fits, but is below the profile's target. nexcrate replaces it as soon as a release in the target resolution appears.
noProfile: {{label}} has no profile yet. Without a profile nexcrate cannot judge anything.

rejections.quality_not_allowed: The quality {{quality}} is not allowed in this profile.
rejections.score_below_minimum: {{score}} points are not enough. The profile needs at least {{minimum}}.
rejections.too_small: At {{size}} the release is too small. The profile needs at least {{minimum}}.
rejections.too_large: At {{size}} the release is too large. At most {{maximum}} is allowed.
rejections.unknown_quality: nexcrate recognises no quality in the name.
rejections.not_enough_seeders_one: The torrent has only {{seeders}} seeder. This indexer needs at least {{minimum}}.
rejections.not_enough_seeders_other: The torrent has only {{seeders}} seeders. This indexer needs at least {{minimum}}.
rejections.protocol_disabled_usenet: The version does not use Usenet (protocol and waiting time).
rejections.protocol_disabled_torrent: The version does not use torrents (protocol and waiting time).
rejections.older_than_retention: The release is {{age}} days old. The news servers of your Usenet clients keep articles for only {{retention}} days.

upgrade.better: That would be an improvement over the existing file.
upgrade.notBetter: That would be no improvement over the existing file.

reasons.worse_quality: The quality is lower than that of the existing file.
reasons.upgrades_disabled: Improving is switched off in this profile.
reasons.cutoff_met: The existing file already has the target quality.
reasons.score_not_higher: It has no more points than the existing file.
reasons.upgrade_until_reached: The existing file already has enough points.
reasons.step_too_small: The gain in points is too small.
reasons.same_release: The file there came from this very release.

series.title: Check a release
series.intro: Paste one or more release names, one per line. nexcrate shows for every version whether it fits, which episodes it covers and why. Nothing is searched and nothing is downloaded.
series.pickHint: Optional. With it nexcrate knows the episodes, runtimes, original language and the files you have.
series.pickNone: No series of the library found.
series.noSeries: Without a series nexcrate knows no runtime and checks no size.
series.versionsHint: Without a choice nexcrate checks every version.
series.missingNames: Paste at least one release name.
series.readTitle: What nexcrate reads in the name

match.none: No episode of this series fits.
match.ambiguous: Not unique. {{other}} would give other episodes: {{codes}}.
match.missing: This series is missing the episodes {{codes}}.
match.unverified_scene: The scene number is not confirmed.
match.not_daily: The release is named by date, but the series is not a daily show.
match.not_anime: The release is counted through as anime is, but the series is not an anime series.
match.group_counting: The group counts by {{scheme}}: another of its releases names an episode that exists only that way.

refused.anime_numbering: This is counted through as anime is (episode {{numbers}}). nexcrate reads that only for series of the type anime.
refused.multi_season: nexcrate does not take packs of several seasons yet.
refused.complete_series: nexcrate does not take a whole series in one pack yet.
refused.split_episode: nexcrate does not take split episodes like S01E05a.
refused.partial_season: nexcrate does not take part of a season.
refused.season_extras: This is bonus material, not an episode.
refused.no_numbering: nexcrate finds neither season and episode nor a date in the name.
refused.implausible_range: The range in the name gives no sensible episode.
refused.unknown: nexcrate does not take this form: {{code}}.

rejections.refused_form: nexcrate does not take this form.
rejections.no_episode_match: No episode of this series fits the name.
rejections.season_incomplete_one: The season has not aired in full. {{value}} episode is still to come.
rejections.season_incomplete_other: The season has not aired in full. {{value}} episodes are still to come.
rejections.already_imported: An episode file is there already from this very release. Loading it again would bring the same files.

notes.runtime_unknown: Without a runtime nexcrate checks no size.
notes.title_mismatch: The title in the name does not fit this series.

series.forNowHint: It fits, but it is below the target of the profile. TRaSH puts both resolutions in one group, so nexcrate replaces it only with a release that has more points.
series.episodesTitle: What would happen to the episodes

episodes.not_watched: Not monitored, nothing would be stored
episodes.file_covers_more: The file holds more episodes than the release.
episodes.summary: Would fill {{fills}} episodes and replace {{replaces}} files ({{size}}).

music.title: Release checker
music.intro: Up to 50 names, one per line. nexcrate shows what it reads in the name and what the music profile says about it. Nothing is searched and nothing is downloaded.
music.namesHint: One name per line, at most 50, each up to 500 characters.
music.tooLong: One name is longer than 500 characters.
music.noProfile: Music has no profile yet, so nexcrate only shows what it reads in the names.

read.unsureHint: The name has several hyphens. Where the artist ends is only known once it is matched with the library.

rejections.cue_single_file: An album as one single file with a cue sheet.
rejections.audiobook: An audiobook or radio play. nexcrate is not made for those.
rejections.unknown_quality: The name does not say which quality. Only a search knows the category of the indexer.
rejections.not_the_target: {{step}} is not the target, and “Take what is there first” is off.
rejections.too_small_for_album: Too small for the whole album: {{minutes}} minutes need at least {{size}} even as low MP3.
rejections.protocol_disabled_usenet: The version does not use Usenet (protocol and waiting time).
rejections.protocol_disabled_torrent: The version does not use torrents (protocol and waiting time).
rejections.not_enough_seeders: {{seeders}} seeders, the indexer asks for at least {{minimum}}.
rejections.older_than_retention: The release is {{age}} days old. The news servers of your Usenet clients keep articles for only {{retention}} days.

notes.below_target: Below the target of the profile. nexcrate replaces it once a release of the target comes.
notes.above_target: Better than the target. It is only taken while there is no high MP3.
notes.mp3_assumed: A scene name without a format means MP3. Only the file says the bitrate.
notes.repeat_first: A repeat (REPACK, PROPER) goes before the first try.
notes.tribute: Sounds like a tribute album. The search refuses it when the album asked for is none.
notes.karaoke: Sounds like karaoke. The search refuses it when the album asked for is none.
notes.format_from_category: The name gives no format. The indexer's category does.
notes.category_differs: The indexer's category says otherwise than the name. The name counts.
notes.small_for_step: Small for {{step}}: about {{kbit}} kbit/s over the whole album.
notes.large_for_album: Very large for {{minutes}} minutes of music.
notes.other_edition: By its name another edition than the target release. Which one it is shows only once it is loaded.
notes.other_edition_media_one: By its name another edition with {{value}} disc. Which one it is shows only once it is loaded.
notes.other_edition_media_other: By its name another edition with {{value}} discs. Which one it is shows only once it is loaded.
